gloss: the first party (A); shell; back of the hand

definitions.gloss: the first; party A (in contracts); grade A
definitions.explanation: The first of a series, used like "A" in "A and B". In Japanese contracts the two parties are called {甲|こう} and {乙|おつ}, and older grading systems used {甲|こう} as the top grade.
The hard shell of a turtle, crab or similar animal, and by extension a protective covering such as a piece of armor.

definitions.gloss: the back of the hand; the top of the foot
definitions.explanation: The upper side of the hand ({手|て}の{甲|こう}) or of the foot ({足|あし}の{甲|こう}), as opposed to the palm or the sole.

examples.japanese: {甲|こう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乙|おつ}→乙：23000_otsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: Party A shall pay Party B the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{売|う}り{手|て}→売り手：24769_urite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甲|こう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the contract, the seller is referred to as Party A.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どちらも→どちらも：08721_dochiramo⟧すばらしく、⟦{甲|こう}{乙|おつ}→甲乙：10046_kouotsu⟧つけがたい。
examples.english: Both works are excellent, and it is hard to say which is better.
You take off the crab's shell and eat the meat.

examples.japanese: {亀|かめ}の{甲|こう}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{年|とし}の{功|こう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{助言|じょげん}→助言：05461_jogen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: As the saying goes, age brings wisdom, and my grandmother's advice is always on the mark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手|て}の{甲|こう}→手の甲：06438_tenokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すりむいた→すりむく：09100_surimuku⟧。
examples.english: I scraped the back of my hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|あし}の{甲|こう}→足の甲：29753_ashinokou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧。
examples.english: I have high insteps, so shoes feel tight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手|て}の{甲|こう}→手の甲：06438_tenokou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧しやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ハンドクリーム→ハンドクリーム：31323_handokuriimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: In winter the backs of my hands dry out easily, so I can't do without hand cream.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {甲|こう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{乙|おつ}→乙：23000_otsu⟧: party A and party B (contracts)
- ⟦{甲乙|こうおつ}→甲乙：10046_kouotsu⟧つけがたい: hard to say which is better
- ⟦{手|て}の{甲|こう}→手の甲：06438_tenokou⟧ / ⟦{足|あし}の{甲|こう}→足の甲：29753_ashinokou⟧: back of the hand / top of the foot
- {亀|かめ}の{甲|こう}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{年|とし}の{功|こう}: age and experience are worth more than a turtle's shell (a pun on こう)

WATCH OUT:
In contracts {甲|こう} and ⟦{乙|おつ}→乙：23000_otsu⟧ are labels, not names: the contract defines who is which in its opening lines. {甲|こう} is also the first of the ten heavenly stems ({十干|じっかん}), from which the A-grade sense comes.
